name: All 13 types keep the same geometry instances and capacities
Updated poses are finite and never change world position or health
Ordinary zombies have visibly paler skin while bosses retain their palettes
Existing skeleton gives a measurable shoulder twist without extra meshes
Night outfits and all combat definitions are unchanged
Skin adds no sampler, texture lookup, animated wound uniform or extra noise calls
Wounds keep per-instance stable seeds and trouser/white-flash exclusion
Five-second story uses nine pooled actors moving toward gate zero on real floor
Story actors never register real enemies, rewards, attacks or particles
Replaying story resets animation state and deterministic starting positions
